description: Run a synthetic two-participant call (camera and microphone) through Synento’s real WebSocket endpoint into a new session in the project, then verify it from the recording. Proves the Synento side works for this project; it does not run or test the app’s code — use verify_session for that. Takes about five seconds. (Requires scope mcp:write.)
name: run_media_check
title: Run synthetic media check
